hero.line: From Pärnu to the Sahara and home through the Arctic: 14 months in our VW LT31 camper van.
hero.caption: Merzouga, Morocco

plan.title: A year on the road, out and back from Estonia
paragraphs: This is a lifetime goal: a long, slow camper tour of Europe and North Africa, starting and finishing at our base in Estonia.

Part one heads south through the Baltics, Central Europe and the Balkans, across Italy to Spain for La Vuelta, then Portugal, and a loop through Morocco to the Sahara with a climb of Toubkal. The van then stays in storage at Málaga over the winter while we fly home.

Part two comes home the long way through Spain, France, the Alps and Germany, then by ferry from Kiel to Lithuania and up through Latvia, in time for the Song Festival (Laulupidu) in Tallinn. Then north into the Arctic to Tromsø and back down the Norwegian fjords.
We travel base to base. The van stays one to five nights at each base, and we see the places nearby on foot, by bike or by train.
This site is our working plan. Change the start date and every date moves with it; festivals are checked again against the new dates.

chapters_intro: Each chapter runs from one week to three months and ends where the trip changes: a ferry, a border, a season or a stop at home.
